Method of Attack: Trojanized ISO files posing as legitimate Windows 10 installers delivering malware capable of collecting data, deploying additional malicious tools, and exfiltrating stolen data
Disabling Windows security telemetry, blocking automatic updates and license verification
Deployment of Stowaway, Beacon, and Sparepart backdoors for maintaining access, executing commands, transferring files, and stealing credentials and keystrokes
Attack Vector: Distribution via Ukrainian and Russian language torrent file-sharing platforms (e.g., toloka.to)
Indicators of Compromise: ISO hosted on toloka.to Ukrainian torrent tracker
Scheduled tasks set up in mid-July 2022
